QuestInfo.name: [Ghost Park] Spooky Pockets
QuestInfo.0: Spiegelmann has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.1: Spiegelmann has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.2: The Pocket Slot Support Event will open in #bGhost Park#k from #b2/10/2016#k to #b23:59:59 on 3/10/2016#k. You will have a chance to get #b#i2022745:#   #t2022745:##k while hunting in Ghost Park during the event.

0.0: You can obtain #b7 kinds of charms#k from hunting ghosts in the Ghost Park.
0.1: But the problem is that those charms...\r\nThey are #bPocket#k Slot items. You remember your #bPocket#k Slot, right?
0.2: The Pocket Slot requires you to have your #bCharm Trait at Lv. 30 or above#k to use. It's been troubling, having so many heroes being unable to open their Pocket Slot. Those charms took a lot of effort to make!
0.3: Therefore, I now present a perfect Pocket Slot Opening Event, to coincide with the Grand Opening of the #bGhost Park#k, from #b2/11/2016#b to #b3/10/2016#k!
0.4: If you hunt ghosts in the Ghost Park during the event duration, you'll have a chance to find #b#i2022745:#   #t2022745:##k items. Visit my park and become more charming, all at once! It's no coincidence! Ha ha ha!

yes.0: Heh, then I'll be waiting for you in... GHOOOOOST PAAAAARK woooooo...

no.0: What, you don't want to be charming?
